description: Effective flat reflective LCD, not a reconstruction of the proprietary Time 2 optical stack.
assumptions: Ideal crossed polarizers and a 45-degree retarder; angular path length follows Snell refraction in a homogeneous slab.
Depolarizing diffuse reflector; independent incident and exit paths; no inter-layer multiple scattering.
Each two-bit primary is an area-weighted mixture of open and closed subpixels; actual pixel geometry is not known.
Gaussian color filters and equal-energy illumination; runtime colored lighting uses an RGB approximation.
Normal-incidence white reflection and backlight are assumed normalization targets, not measured radiometric units.
Rotationally symmetric response; no azimuthal birefringence, pixel diffraction, lens curvature or nonuniformity.
Diffuse environment response is integrated for isotropic illumination, then scaled by the environment irradiance.
Glass Fresnel reflection is evaluated separately by the browser; it is not included twice in the table.
